reason: A native Windows Electron desktop shell that packages and launches the DeepSeek Harness Web UI with tray integration, notifications, single-instance behavior, optional startup, and update support.

summaries.zh: 这是一个将 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 封装为原生 Windows 桌面应用的 Electron 客户端，提供系统托盘、原生通知、单实例运行、可选开机自启和自动更新。
summaries.en: An Electron-based Windows desktop client that wraps the DeepSeek Harness Web UI with system tray integration, native notifications, single-instance behavior, optional startup, and update support.

capabilities: Wraps and launches the bundled DeepSeek Harness CLI
Stores a DeepSeek API key in a local environment file
Runs in the Windows system tray and can configure startup on login
Downloads updates in the background for installed builds
